queries.sql:
SELECT module, COUNT(*) AS edit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT user_name) AS editors,
        SUM(CASE WHEN action = 'AI_ACCEPT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ai_suggestions_accepted,
        SUM(delta) AS net_value_change, MAX(timestamp) AS latest_change
      FROM SNOWCONSO_AXA_DE.PUBLIC.FACT_AUDIT_TRAIL
      WHERE timestamp > DATEADD('hour', -48, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
      GROUP BY module ORDER BY edit_count DESC
